# dreamrouter_wans (Data Source)

Lists the router's internet connections with the port each uses and its live state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dreamrouter_wans" "all" {}

output "connections" {
  value = { for w in data.dreamrouter_wans.all.wans : w.name => "${w.port}: ${w.up ? w.ip : "down"} (${w.role})" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `wans` (Attributes List) The connections, primary first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wans))

<a id="nestedatt--wans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wans`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The connection's ID.
- `ip` (String) Its public address; empty if down.
- `name` (String) e.g. "Internet 1".
- `network_group` (String) "WAN" (Internet 1) or "WAN2" (Internet 2).
- `port` (String) The port it uses, e.g. "Port 4"; empty if none.
- `role` (String) "primary", "failover" or "load balanced".
- `type` (String) "pppoe", "dhcp" or "static".
- `up` (Boolean) Whether the connection is up.
- `username` (String) PPPoE username; empty otherwise.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID; 0 if none.
